units.source_text: 源氏公子告辞住吉神社后，到处逍遥游览。

en.t: After Prince Genji took leave of Sumiyoshi Shrine, he wandered about here and there at leisure.

units.source_text: 他在难波浦举行祓禊，在七濑举行的特别庄严隆重。

en.t: He performed purification rites at Naniwa Bay, and the ceremony held at Nanase was especially solemn and grand.

units.source_text: 他眺望难波的堀江一带，不知不觉地吟诵古歌：

en.t: As he gazed over the Horie area of Naniwa, he unconsciously recited an old poem:
“The pain of longing is carved into my bones; by now I can no longer bear it.

units.source_text: 誓当图相见，纵使舍身命。”

en.t: I swear I will seek a way to meet her, even if I must give up my life.”

units.source_text: 流露了对明石姬思念的心事。

en.t: It revealed the feelings in his heart as he longed for the lady of Akashi.

units.source_text: 近在车旁的惟光听了吟诵，立刻会意，

en.t: Koremitsu, who was close beside the carriage, heard the recitation and immediately understood his meaning,

units.source_text: 便从怀中取出旅中备用的短管毛笔来，于停车时呈上。

en.t: so he took from his robe a short-handled brush kept ready for travel and presented it when the carriage stopped.

units.source_text: 源氏公子接了笔，心念这惟光真机灵，便在一张便条纸上写道：

en.t: Prince Genji accepted the brush, thinking how quick-witted Koremitsu was, and wrote on a sheet of note paper:
